observations: Darker backgrounds print better than white

configuration.method: Artist-selected RGB prebias: retain black; modestly emphasize chromatic cyan and reduce chromatic magenta in a simple CMY decomposition; lift foreground lightness and compress saturation for dark-ground contrast. Neutral grays use explicit green-biased replacements. This does not control six-channel ink separation or emulate a measured ICC profile.
configuration.calibration: Unmeasured visual hypotheses; parameters are not estimates of ink loss or paper response.
